sentences.en: And then you add climate change to the equation.
sentences.zh: 然后你再把气候变化这个因素加进去。

sentences.en: All across the western U.S., we're seeing a
sentences.zh: 在整个美国西部，我们在

sentences.en: growing number of days in a given year that have the right conditions for extreme fire.
sentences.zh: 一年中看到越来越多的天数具备极端火灾的气象条件。

sentences.en: And a lot of these new fire weather days are happening in the late fall.
sentences.zh: 而许多这样的新型火险天气都发生在深秋。

sentences.en: Typically, Northern California can expect a good soaking rain by November, which effectively
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，北加州在11月会迎来一场透雨，这实际上

sentences.en: brings an end to that year's fire danger.
sentences.zh: 宣告了当年火险的结束。

sentences.en: But in 2018, the first winter storms were stubbornly behind
sentences.zh: 但在2018年，第一场冬雨却迟迟

sentences.en: And following one of the hottest summers on record, the landscape was kiln dry.
sentences.zh: 在经历了有记录以来最炎热的夏天之后，整个地表干得就像窑烤一样。

sentences.en: How aware of wildfire as an issue were you in Paradise?
sentences.zh: 你在天堂镇时对野火这个问题有多大意识？

sentences.en: Fire risk was not some great secret in Paradise.
sentences.zh: 在天堂镇，火灾风险并不是什么天大的秘密。

sentences.en: The town wasn't on the edge of the foreSt. It was
sentences.zh: 这个小镇并不在森林边缘。它

sentences.en: built right among the Doug firs and the Ponderosa pines.
sentences.zh: 就是建在道格拉斯冷杉和黄松之间的。

sentences.en: But Susan and John Michael were never
sentences.zh: 但苏珊和约翰·迈克尔从来没有

sentences.en: Their house wasn't at the end of some backcountry dirt road.
sentences.zh: 他们的房子不在偏远的泥土小路尽头。

sentences.en: They had neighbors all around them, and they felt a false sense of suburban safety.
sentences.zh: 他们的四邻都是居民，这让他们产生了一种虚假的郊区安全感。

sentences.en: A couple of weeks before the fire, we said, it's never going to get to us.
sentences.zh: 就在火灾发生前几周，我们还说，火是永远不会烧到我们这里的。

sentences.en: They had actually just gone to a fire safety workshop at the Paradise Grange,
sentences.zh: 他们其实刚刚去过天堂镇格兰奇集会举办的一个消防安全讲座，

sentences.en: where they learned all about the town's evacuation protocol.
sentences.zh: 在那里他们了解了镇上的疏散方案。

sentences.en: They learned that in order to control traffic, every neighborhood had been given a zone.
sentences.zh: 他们了解到为了控制交通，每个居民区都被划分了一个区域。

sentences.en: And on the day, you know, if the fire happened, you're supposed to turn on your emergency radio station
sentences.zh: 如果发生火灾，你知道的，到了那天，你应该打开紧急广播电台，

sentences.en: and wait for your zone to be called.
sentences.zh: 等待广播呼叫你所在的安全区。

sentences.en: You know, there was a plan.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当时是有计划的。

sentences.en: The campfire erupted on the morning of November 8th.
sentences.zh: 坎普大火于11月8日早晨爆发。

sentences.en: It was a classic fire weather day, with a hot,
sentences.zh: 那是一个典型的火险天气，一股炎热、

sentences.en: dry, ominous wind whipping down off the western slope of the Sierras.
sentences.zh: 干燥、不祥的风从内华达山脉西坡呼啸而下。

sentences.en: Susan had gone to a doctor's appointment early that morning.
sentences.zh: 那天一大早苏珊就去看医生了。

sentences.en: And when she got out of her car,
she saw a bunch of people in the parking lot pointing at the sky.
sentences.zh: 她看到停车场里有一群人正指着天空。

sentences.en: And there's a big glow in the sky, like, bigger than any, like a sunrise, right?
sentences.zh: 天空中有一团巨大的红光，就像，比任何日出都要大，对吧？

sentences.en: And I said, is that a fire?
I said, well, wow, that's big.
And they said, yeah, and it's windy.
sentences.zh: 他们说，对啊，而且风很大。

sentences.en: Earlier that morning, a piece of equipment belonging to the power company PG&E
sentences.zh: 那天早些时候，电力公司太平洋天然气和电力公司的一台设备

sentences.en: had malfunctioned near the town of Polga.
sentences.zh: 在波尔加镇附近发生故障。

sentences.en: It sparked a small blaze, but it didn't take long
sentences.zh: 它引发了一场小火，但没过多久，

sentences.en: for the 30-mile-an-hour winds to whip up an inferno.
sentences.zh: 时速30英里的狂风就把火势煽成了一场大火灾。

sentences.en: When she got home, Susan turned on the radio.
sentences.zh: 苏珊一回到家就打开了收音机。

sentences.en: This is an emergency notification for the town of Paradise.
sentences.zh: 这是一条针对天堂镇的紧急通知。

sentences.en: The voice on the radio said that they were evacuating certain neighborhoods in Paradise,
sentences.zh: 收音机里的声音说，他们正在疏散天堂镇的某些居民区，

sentences.en: Please stand by for other zones.
sentences.zh: 请等待其他区域的通知。

sentences.en: But then she noticed that her next-door neighbors were leaving in their RV.
sentences.zh: 但随后她注意到隔壁邻居正开着房车离开。

sentences.en: And they couldn't get out onto the road.
sentences.zh: 然而他们却开不上大路。

sentences.en: And that's the first time I noticed, wow, there's traffic.
sentences.zh: 那是我就注意到，哇，有车流。

sentences.en: There's a line of traffic on the road.
sentences.zh: 路上排起了长长的车队。

sentences.en: And just then the electricity went off.
Susan turned on her car radio so she could keep listening as they got ready to leave.
sentences.zh: 苏珊打开了汽车收音机，这样他们在准备离开时就能继续收听。

sentences.en: And that's the first time I realized and noticed that I turned it on at 8 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时我意识到并发现，我是在8点钟打开收音机的。

sentences.en: This is the same message that's been playing.
Please stand by for other zones.
sentences.zh: 请等待其他区域的通知。

sentences.en: The emergency message was playing on a loop.
sentences.zh: 紧急广播一直在循环播放。
他们已经放弃那个紧急电台了。

sentences.en: So then I said, OK, honey, we got to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 于是我说，好吧，亲爱的，我们得离开这里。

sentences.en: They pulled the car out of the driveway and went absolutely nowhere.
sentences.zh: 他们把车开出车道，结果根本寸步难行。
车流首尾相接，水泄不通。

sentences.en: Like, we got maybe 500 yards in 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们花了45分钟大概只开了500码远。

sentences.en: You can see the glow of the fire, you know, off in the distance.
There was no way to know if the traffic was going to improve.
sentences.zh: 根本无法知道交通状况会不会有所改善。

sentences.en: And so Susan and John Michael ducked into a church parking lot to figure out a plan.
sentences.zh: 于是苏珊和约翰·迈克尔把车拐进了一个教堂停车场，商量对策。

sentences.en: Susan actually had a brochure from the fire training that she had gone to a couple of weeks before.
sentences.zh: 苏珊随身带着几周前参加消防培训时拿的一份小册子。

sentences.en: It was like they had a checkliSt. Do this, do this, do that, do that.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像他们有一份检查清单一样。做这个，做那个，做这个，做那个。

sentences.en: I'm just struck by the fact that you're in, like, the midst of the biggest crisis of your life and you're, like, reading a brochure.
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊的是，你正处在人生中最大的危机之中，而你居然在读小册子。

sentences.en: Because we had just gone to the workshop, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我们刚刚去参加过那个讲座，对吧？

sentences.en: Except the brochure said that if they couldn't get out, they should lie on the ground, put a blanket over their head, and shelter in place.
sentences.zh: 但小册子上说，如果他们无法撤离，就应该趴在地上，用毯子护住头部，就地避难。

sentences.en: Susan was not particularly excited about this idea.
sentences.zh: 苏珊对这个主意可是一点也高兴不起来。

sentences.en: It seemed like such a last resort kind of move.
sentences.zh: 这听起来实在是一种万不得已的最后手段。

sentences.en: I looked at John Michael and said, are we going to do this?
sentences.zh: 我看着约翰·迈克尔说，我们要这么做吗？

sentences.en: I said, okay, what are we going to do?
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，那我们怎么办？

sentences.en: There was no way to get anywhere in a car.
sentences.zh: 开车根本去不了任何地方。

sentences.en: But John Michael thought he knew a back trail through the woods that would take them to a larger parking lot that would feel a lot safer.
sentences.zh: 但约翰·迈克尔觉得他知道一条穿过树林的后山小路，能带他们到一个感觉安全得多的较大停车场。

sentences.en: And so we just took what we could on our backs, took the dog, forgot my phone.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是背着能带的东西，带上了狗，却把手机落下了。

sentences.en: He took his ukulele so we'd have something to do.
sentences.zh: 他带了尤克里里，这样我们能有点事做。

sentences.en: And we walked down the road to cut through the woods to get over to a holiday market parking lot.
sentences.zh: 我们顺着路走，穿过树林，去到一个假日市场的停车场。

sentences.en: And the only time I think really that we were afraid was as we were going through that was we didn't know if there was going to be fire on the other side or what the, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想我们真正害怕的时候，是在穿过那里的时候，我们不知道另一边会不会有火灾，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: if we could get trapped in the woods by fire.
sentences.zh: 我们是否会被大火困在树林里。

sentences.en: So we stopped and I said, honey, this is what all of our spiritual practice has been about.
sentences.zh: 所以我们停下来，我对他说，亲爱的，这就是我们所有灵修实践派上用场的时候了。

sentences.en: If this is our last day, you know, I'll see you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 如果这是我们的最后一天，你知道的，我在另一边等你。

sentences.en: While Susan and John Michael were hiking through the woods, Crystal was battling traffic on the one road off the ridge.
sentences.zh: 正当苏珊和约翰·迈克尔在树林里徒步时，克丽丝塔正在岭上一条通往外界的公路上与车流艰难搏斗。

sentences.en: The news of the fire had come earlier at her trailer park.
sentences.zh: 火灾的消息早些时候就已经传到了她所在的拖车公园。

sentences.en: A police officer showed up around 11 in the morning and just told them to get the hell out of there.
sentences.zh: 早上11点左右，一名警察出现，直接让他们赶紧离开那里。

sentences.en: And the sheriffs came through there saying, get out of here.
sentences.zh: 治安官也路过那里，喊着赶紧离开这里。
天堂镇的所有人都收到了强制疏散令。

sentences.en: Get down to Chico or get down to wherever you can get to.
sentences.zh: 去奇科，或者去任何你能去的地方。

sentences.en: Doesn't matter which roads you take, just go.
sentences.zh: 走哪条路不重要，只管走就行。

sentences.en: Crystal and a group of neighbors piled into an old RV and headed down the Skyway, the main road out of town.
sentences.zh: 克丽丝塔和一群邻居挤进一辆老旧的房车，朝着镇外的主路天空大道驶去。

sentences.en: We've got the fire coming down down Skyway.
sentences.zh: 大火正顺着天空大道蔓延下来。
我们在天空大道和莫皮街的交界处。

sentences.en: We've got the road completely blocked.
We need somebody to be able to open it up and get the female out of here.
sentences.zh: 我们需要有人来把路打开，让这个女人离开这里。

sentences.en: The whole ride out of there just seemed like we were in the towering inferno.
sentences.zh: 一路上逃出来的时候，感觉就像身处火烧摩天楼里一样。

sentences.en: Well, the sky was nothing but flames, all the way around us.
sentences.zh: 嗯，天空到处都是火焰，把我们团团围住。

sentences.en: It's like these big old fireballs just like shooting everywhere.
sentences.zh: 就像这些巨大的火球到处乱飞。

sentences.en: There just weren't enough roads for everyone up there to evacuate all at once.
sentences.zh: 上面的道路根本不够所有人同时撤离。

sentences.en: But after several hours stuck in the most terrifying traffic jam of her life, Crystal finally made it down off the ridge safely.
sentences.zh: 但在经历了她这辈子最惊恐的交通大堵塞几个小时后，克丽丝塔终于安全撤到了山岭下方。

sentences.en: Oh my God, I can't believe we're alive.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，我真不敢相信我们还活着。

sentences.en: Back up the hill, Susan and John Michael somehow managed to find a safe path through the woods, carrying John Michael's ukulele.
sentences.zh: 回到山上，苏珊和约翰·迈克尔不知怎么设法在树林里找到了一条安全的小路，手里还拿着约翰·迈克尔的尤克里里。

sentences.en: And they ended up in a different parking lot outside of a holiday market where they were met by a bunch of Cal Fire officials.
sentences.zh: 他们最后来到了假日市场外面另一个不同的停车场，在那里遇到了一群加州消防局的官员。

sentences.en: We went up to one of them and said, what do we do?
sentences.zh: 我们走到其中一人面前问，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: And he said, stay here, you'll be safe here.
sentences.zh: 他说，待在这里，在这里你们是安全的。

sentences.en: This parking lot was safer than the last one.
sentences.zh: 这个停车场比上一个更安全。

sentences.en: And visually, it was kind of shielded from the worst of the fire.
sentences.zh: 而且从视觉上看，它在一定程度上挡住了最猛烈的火势。

sentences.en: And so as the afternoon dragged on, Susan and John Michael didn't really have a sense for how bad things had gotten.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着下午时光流逝，苏珊和约翰·迈克尔并没有真正意识到情况已经变得多么糟糕。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, the county sheriffs came and picked them up.
sentences.zh: 天黑时分，县治安官来接走了他们。

sentences.en: So I said, can we take you down to Chico, ma'am?
sentences.zh: 所以我说，女士，我们可以带你们去奇科吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, you know, we'd like to just go back to our house if it's all the same to you.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你不介意的话，我们其实只想回我们的房子。

sentences.en: And they're like, they looked at me like I was out of my mind and say, no, there's fire everywhere, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 他们看着我，眼神就像看一个疯子一样，说，不行，到处都是大火，女士。

sentences.en: So I thought, all right, they maybe have to do this, you know.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，好吧，他们也许必须这么做，你知道的。

sentences.en: So we get in the car with them and not two blocks away, every direction that you look is flames.
sentences.zh: 于是我们上了他们的车，还没开出两个街区，放眼望去各个方向全都是火焰。

sentences.en: You look all the way down this way.
sentences.zh: 你顺着这边一直望过去。

sentences.en: It's like a disaster set from a movie.
sentences.zh: 就像电影里的灾难片布景。

sentences.en: So many people evoke movies when they're trying to describe what it feels like to be in the middle of a disaster,
sentences.zh: 很多人在试图描述身处灾难之中的感受时，都会联想到电影，

sentences.en: I think it's because there's really nothing from day-to-day life that could possibly serve as a point of comparison.
sentences.zh: 我想这是因为日常生活中真的没有什么东西可以作为对比的参照。

sentences.en: The fire was just too intense for normal language, too otherworldly.
sentences.zh: 这场大火实在太猛烈，超出了日常语言的范畴，太超乎寻常了。

sentences.en: And the level of destruction really was the stuff of alien invasions.
sentences.zh: 而破坏的程度简直就像外星人入侵一样。

sentences.en: Nearly the entire town was incinerated that day, turned to white ash.
sentences.zh: 那天几乎整个镇子都被烧成了灰烬，变成了一片白色的灰堆。

sentences.en: Susan and John Michael lost their home and everything in it.
sentences.zh: 苏珊和约翰·迈克尔失去了他们的家以及里面的一切。

sentences.en: Somehow, Susan's car, which they abandoned at that first church parking lot, survived.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，苏珊的车——他们丢在第一个教堂停车场的车——竟然完好无损。

sentences.en: Although, one side of it got all melty.
sentences.zh: 虽然车身的一侧都被烤化了。

sentences.en: Still drives it around like a badge of honor.
sentences.zh: 依然开着它到处跑，就像一枚荣誉勋章。

sentences.en: Crystal also lost most of her possessions that day.
sentences.zh: 那天克丽丝塔也失去了大部分财产。

sentences.en: The trailer park where she lived and worked partially burned during the fire.
sentences.zh: 她生活和工作的拖车公园在火灾中部分被烧毁。

sentences.en: And she was so traumatized by her experiences that she never wanted to go up on the ridge again.
sentences.zh: 她的经历给她带来了巨大的心理创伤，以至于她再也不想回到山岭上去了。

sentences.en: All three of them, though, were lucky to make it out alive.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们三个人都幸运地活着逃了出来。

sentences.en: Eighty-five people died in the campfire.
sentences.zh: 坎普大火夺去了八十五人的生命。

sentences.en: But even before the extent of that tragedy was fully understood,
sentences.zh: 但甚至在这场悲剧的严重程度被完全了解之前，

sentences.en: it was clear that another disaster was starting to unfold.
sentences.zh: 很明显，另一场灾难正在拉开帷幕。

sentences.en: One that would impact Susan and Crystal in very different ways.
sentences.zh: 这场灾难将以截然不同的方式影响苏珊和克丽丝塔。

sentences.en: That's coming up after the break.
The campfire displaced roughly 50,000 people from the ridge above Chico.
sentences.zh: 坎普大火导致奇科上方山岭上的大约五万人流离失所。

sentences.en: And over time, the diaspora of fire survivors fanned out across the country.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，火灾幸存者的流散人群散布到了全国各地。

sentences.en: People moved to be closer to family or further away from their own trauma.
sentences.zh: 人们搬家是为了离家人更近，或者离自己的创伤更远。

sentences.en: Researchers at Chico State have found fire survivors in all 50 states.
sentences.zh: 奇科州立大学的研究人员在全美所有50个州都发现了火灾幸存者的踪迹。

sentences.en: But the majority of people did not go very far.
sentences.zh: 但大多数人并没有走太远。

sentences.en: At least 15,000 of them ended up down the hill in Chico,
sentences.zh: 其中至少有1.5万人最终来到了山下的奇科，

sentences.en: a town that was struggling to keep its existing population fully housed,
sentences.zh: 这个原本就难以确保现有居民都有充足住房的城镇，

sentences.en: grew by more than 15% in one day.
sentences.zh: 在一天之内增长了15%以上。

sentences.en: You know, we would have never imagined ourselves to be walking down the street in Chico
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们做梦也没想到自己会走在奇科的街头，
却没有一个可以去的地方。

sentences.en: It was hard to get a room in Sacramento,
sentences.zh: 要在萨克拉门托找个房间都很难，

sentences.en: a city of half a million people that's 90 miles away.
sentences.zh: 那是一座拥有五十万人口、距离九十英里远的城市。

sentences.en: And so Susan and John Michael found themselves in a McDonald's,
sentences.zh: 于是苏珊和约翰·迈克尔发现自己身处一家麦当劳里，
翻看着他们的联系人列表。

sentences.en: It was like, okay, what friends are going to take us in?
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，好吧，有哪些朋友会收留我们？

sentences.en: You know, who can we ask this of?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们能向谁开这个口？

sentences.en: Sometimes when I think about the fire,
sentences.zh: 有时每当我想到那场大火，

sentences.en: I think about the metaphor of a staircase.
sentences.zh: 我就会想起楼梯的隐喻。

sentences.en: Everyone who was up on the ridge that day fell down the stairs.
